judgement.reason: The single gunicorn web app with managed PostgreSQL can run after contained changes, and the sandbox, computer and search services are optional add-ons.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 3 application services (sandbox, computer, server). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The computer service is optional and only enabled when KHOJ_OPERATOR_ENABLED is set, so the shown lines suggest the production app runs as one server process; the sandbox still needs vendor confirmation.

evidence.quote: # Set KHOJ_OPERATOR_ENABLED=True in the server service environment variable to enable.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume khoj_computer:/home/operator (docker-compose.yml computer), volume khoj_config:/root/.khoj/ (docker-compose.yml server)
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove what /root/.khoj/ holds or that a setting moves this data to PostgreSQL or S3, so durable local state may still be needed.
